title: Task Prioritizer — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Ranks tasks by urgency and importance so the right work gets done first. The Task Prioritizer ranks tasks by urgency and importance. Each task is scored on deadline pressure and impact, then placed in a priority order with the reasoning shown. The student sees exactly why each task ranks where it does, and re-ranking takes seconds when plans change.
capabilities: Score tasks on urgency and importance
Produce a ranked order with reasoning
Show why each task ranks where it does
Re-rank instantly when plans change
Separate urgent-important from busy-work
